tool_description: DermRadiomic extracts handcrafted radiomic features from dermoscopic lesions using PyRadiomics. It requires an image–mask pair and can export a CSV of features plus an optional human-readable TXT summary. Users may choose any subset of the seven PyRadiomics feature classes or supply a YAML parameter file for advanced settings.
demo_commands:
docker run --rm --gpus all 
  -v /home/pathto/ISIC2018:/data 
  derm_radiomic 
  python infer.py --image /data/Test_Data/img.jpg --mask /data/Test_GroundTruth/mask.png --output radiomics_features.csv

docker run --rm --gpus all 
  -v /home/pathto/ISIC2018:/data 
  derm_radiomic 
  python infer.py --image /data/Test_Data/img.jpg --mask /data/Test_GroundTruth/mask.png --output features_shape_glcm.csv --features shape firstorder glcm

docker run --rm --gpus all 
  -v /home/pathto/ISIC2018:/data 
  derm_radiomic 
  python infer.py --image /data/Test_Data/img.jpg --mask /data/Test_GroundTruth/mask.png --output features.csv --output_txt summary.txt --features firstorder glrlm glszm

image.description: Absolute path to the dermoscopic image (JPG, PNG, NIfTI, etc.).

mask.description: Path to the binary segmentation mask corresponding to the image.

output_csv.description: Destination CSV file for the extracted radiomic features.

output_txt.description: (Optional) TXT file for a human-readable summary of key features.

features.description: (Optional) List of feature classes to compute; defaults to all.

param_file.description: (Optional) YAML parameter file with custom PyRadiomics settings.

features_csv.description: Path to the CSV file containing radiomic feature values.

summary_txt.description: (If requested) Path to the TXT summary file.

csv_format.description: One row per image; columns correspond to the selected radiomic features.
